defs.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a vertical sidebar listing all rooms/zones of the home (Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, etc.) with icons, active-device counts, and a currently-selected highlight; selecting a room scopes the rest of the panel to that room.
defs.role: The primary navigation surface that scopes which room's devices and climate the rest of the panel displays.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: When the user selects a room in the sidebar, emit the selected room ID; the Device Control Grid re-queries and re-renders only the devices (lights, switches, plugs, blinds) belonging to that room.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Panel
targets.description: When the user selects a room, emit the room ID; the Climate Control Panel switches to display and control that room's thermostat/zone setpoint and current readings.

defs.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a responsive grid of device control cards for the selected room — each card toggles a device on/off and exposes inline controls (light dimmer/color, plug toggle, blind slider, fan speed) with live status.
defs.role: The main hands-on control surface where the user directly operates the devices of the currently selected room.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room ID and rebuilds the grid to show only that room's devices with their current states.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
effectors.description: When a scene is activated, receives the scene's target device states (on/off, brightness, color, blind position) and updates the matching device cards to reflect those new states.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Dashboard
targets.description: Whenever a device is turned on/off or a dimmer/plug level changes, emit the device's updated power draw so the Energy Dashboard recomputes and re-renders current total and per-device consumption.

defs.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a thermostat control panel with a circular temperature dial, current vs target temperature, heat/cool/auto mode selector, humidity readout, and fan mode for the selected room's zone.
defs.role: The dedicated climate hub that sets and displays temperature and HVAC mode for the selected room and reports HVAC load to the energy dashboard.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room ID and loads that room/zone's current temperature, target setpoint, humidity, and mode into the dial.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
effectors.description: When a scene is activated, receives the scene's target temperature and HVAC mode and updates the dial setpoint and mode selector accordingly.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Dashboard
targets.description: When the setpoint or heat/cool mode changes, emit the resulting HVAC power/energy estimate so the Energy Dashboard updates the climate portion of total consumption.

defs.name: Smart Home: Security & Camera Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a security panel with live camera feed thumbnails, per-door lock toggles, an alarm arm/disarm control with modes (home/away/disarmed), and a recent event/motion log.
defs.role: The home-wide security hub for monitoring cameras and controlling locks and the alarm, driven by scene activations.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
effectors.description: When a scene is activated (e.g. 'Away' or 'Goodnight'), receives the scene's security directive and sets the alarm mode and lock states accordingly (arm away, lock all doors).

defs.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a panel of one-tap scene tiles (Good Morning, Away, Movie Night, Goodnight) and a list of automation rules with enable toggles; activating a scene pushes preset states across devices, climate, and security.
defs.role: The orchestration surface that applies coordinated preset states to devices, climate, and security in a single action.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On scene activation, emit the scene's device state map (which lights/plugs/blinds on/off and their levels); the grid applies these states to the corresponding device cards.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Panel
targets.description: On scene activation, emit the scene's target temperature and HVAC mode; the Climate panel updates its dial setpoint and mode selector.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security & Camera Panel
targets.description: On scene activation, emit the scene's security directive; the Security panel sets alarm mode and lock states to match.

defs.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Dashboard
defs.genInstructions: Build an energy monitoring dashboard with a real-time total-consumption gauge, a per-device/per-category breakdown chart, and a historical usage trend line for the home.
defs.role: The analytics surface that aggregates and visualizes real-time and historical power consumption driven by device and climate activity.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives updated per-device power draw whenever devices are toggled or dimmed, and recomputes the total gauge and per-device breakdown.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Climate Control Panel
effectors.description: Receives HVAC power/energy estimates when climate setpoint or mode changes, and updates the climate segment of the consumption breakdown and total.
